proposed_widenings.name: choice_mechanics for SpeciesTraitMechanics (build-time pick-one-of-N)
proposed_widenings.justification: Giant Ancestry presents six mechanically distinct options and the character permanently selects one at character creation. SpeciesTraitMechanics = PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no composite or choice variant. Each option has a different activation cost (bonus_action, on-hit, reaction) so they cannot share a single ActivatedAbilityMechanics record.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.on_caster_attack_hit
proposed_widenings.justification: Fire's Burn, Frost's Chill, and Hill's Tumble are optional additions that fire when the character lands an attack roll and deals damage — consuming one use. No ClassFeatureActivationCost variant captures 'when you hit with an attack roll you may optionally activate this.' The existing reaction kind carries ReactionTrigger which is defensive (hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_spell) not offensive.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.take_damage (and ranged variant for Storm's Thunder)
proposed_widenings.justification: Stone's Endurance fires 'when you take damage' and Storm's Thunder fires 'when you take damage from a creature within 60 feet.' Neither trigger exists in ReactionTrigger, which currently covers hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, creature_casts_spell, spell_save_outcome, and any_of. A take_damage trigger variant with an optional range filter is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. / When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

notes: Surface widenings since the previous result resolved several blockers: SpeciesTraitRecord kind, UseCountCap.proficiency_bonus, teleport atom, modify_speed atom, and reduce_damage_taken atom are all now present in types.ts. The remaining blockers are structural: (1) no pick-one-of-N mechanics choice shape in SpeciesTraitMechanics; (2) no on-caster-attack-hit activation cost for the three optional on-hit sub-options; (3) no take-damage reaction trigger for Stone's Endurance and Storm's Thunder. Cloud's Jaunt (bonus_action teleport, PB uses, long rest) and Hill's Tumble (on-hit, apply prone) would encode cleanly once the choice structure and on-hit cost exist. The individual effect atoms are all present in types.ts.
